Signal widths were also estimated at 0.46 characters, which is not what a proportional serif measures, so even the relaxation that did exist was separating boxes that did not describe the pixels. Added a claimed-box registry (CXBOX) with boxFree/claim/put/sides plus a measured-width cache, filling in the `var boxes = []` stub the v7 author left. Ron's rule, nudge then drop: every non-signal label tries its natural side, the mirrored side, then 13px above and below, and is not drawn if none is clear. Labels are emitted in importance order (signals, then link, dive, scen, co, cand, evt) so a headline can no longer take the space a link name needed by arriving first in the node array. Signal names keep their leader lines and their nudge loop, now on measured widths, and flip to the mirrored side before they are ever dropped. The area outside freeRect (the panel, the inspector, the topbar, the bottom rail) is reserved, and signal names are SLID into it rather than dropped, because spending a whole title to avoid a five-pixel overlap with the topbar is the wrong trade. The focused ring's read-out, the radial title and the factor legend claim first and always draw. | health: measured, not eyeballed.
